title: Count Largest Group
description:
You are given an integer n.

Consider all numbers from 1 to n (inclusive). Group these numbers based on the sum of their digits.

Two numbers belong to the same group if they have the same digit sum.
Task

Return the number of groups that have the maximum size (i.e., the most elements).

Examples

Example 1
Input: n = 13
Output: 4

Explanation:
Groups based on digit sum:

[1,10], [2,11], [3,12], [4,13], [5], [6], [7], [8], [9]

The largest group size is 2, and there are 4 such groups.

Example 2
Input: n = 2
Output: 2

Explanation:
Groups:

[1], [2]

Each group has size 1, so answer = 2.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 10⁴
